explication: J.A.R.V.I.S. is a browser-based voice assistant split between a React/Three.js face and a Node bridge running Claude Code headlessly. The main workflow is wake/listen, send a request to the brain, run configured tools, then speak the response and update the holographic interface. The graph also preserves the documented camera/hand interaction, HUD panels, and interface-control capabilities. Some links are based on README descriptions because the relevant implementation excerpts were not provided.
